284749099.description:
Natural Petrified Wood Specimen
Agatized Fossilized Wood Display
Natural Mineral Fossil, 10.4 Inches, 2.9 lbs
Substantial natural petrified wood specimen exhibiting well-preserved exterior bark texture alongside a richly silicified interior. Petrified wood forms through permineralization, in which organic plant tissue is buried under sediment and gradually replaced by silica minerals such as chalcedony and agate over millions of years. This freestanding piece displays a varied palette of honey amber, cream, earthy brown, and dark charcoal tones, making it an impressive display piece for fossil and mineral collectors.
Silicified fossil wood with distinct exterior bark and longitudinal grain structure
Polished and natural mineralized faces with chalcedony and agate formations
Cut flat base allowing the specimen to sit upright unsupported for tabletop or shelf display
Measures 10.4 inches long by 6.4 inches wide by 3.8 inches high; weighs approximately 2.9 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in very good display condition. Features expected natural fissures, crevices, and conchoidal fractures typical of agatized wood. Flat cut base is level and stable. No synthetic coatings, glue, or modern repairs detected.
